propositions: Pass 1 must discover grounded candidates only and never assess validity, impact, severity, confidence, drop/block policy, or remediation; any such assessment in Pass 1 instructions is a phase-boundary violation.

Pass 2 must independently verify atomic yes/no questions only and never discover new findings, decide outcomes, or prescribe fixes; any such discovery or prescription in Pass 2 instructions is a phase-boundary violation.
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment; any discretionary or learned decision in Pass 3 instructions is a phase-boundary violation.

Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive guidance only and never re-verify, alter decisions, or dictate exact implementations; any prescriptive instruction or decision alteration in Pass 4 instructions is a phase-boundary violation.

The project criterion `project.review-phase-boundaries` must emit grounded findings for phase-boundary violations (RP-F1..F6) and abstain for legitimate per-phase refinement (RP-N1..N6), with zero severity/confidence fields and empty suggested_fix across twelve balanced test cases, achieving recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, and kappa>=0.70 in three live runs.

Operative instructions must be identifiable to a specific phase and distinguishable from documentation, negative examples, or unchanged grandfathered debt; when phase ownership is unclear or a change is descriptive only, the criterion must abstain.
